evidence.title: GitHub - Arindam200/termui: TypeScript terminal UI framework

name: TermUI Registry
summary: Shadcn-style registry of 113 terminal UI components for React + Ink, installed by CLI.
description: A shadcn-style component registry for terminal interfaces: 113 TypeScript components across 13 categories — layout, typography, input, selection, data display, feedback, navigation, overlays, forms, charts, utility, templates and AI/LLM components. Source is fetched with npx termui add and copied into your project; a schema manifest and per-component meta files back the registry.
contains: install via npx termui add <component> (copies TSX source)
categories incl. layout, typography, input, data display, charts, AI components
AI/LLM components: chat thread, tool call, model selector, context meter
